Definition: from the base of G4639; shadiness, i.e. obscurity (literally or figuratively):--darkness.
BiblicalUsage: Skotos is darkness, and it is the opposite of everything Christ is. Men loved darkness rather than light because their deeds were evil, Paul was sent to turn men from darkness to light and from the power of Satan unto God, and John says if we walk in darkness while claiming fellowship with Him, we lie.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe darkness is not the absence of light but the love of it. Men chose it, and I hold that the light that came into the world is the only cure for the choosing.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
